facts.description: An original single-file Three.js library of seven interactive clothbound hardcovers.

research.name: The Complete Shelf
research.note: Single-file Three.js shelf of seven clothbound hardcovers that can be pulled out, orbited and paged through.

effects: 3D shelf of clothbound hardcover books with cloth texture and foil cover artwork

unverified: Only the README preview screenshot of the shelf view was seen; the live demo at https://mengto.github.io/complete-shelf/ returned HTTP 200 but could not be viewed running because the shared browser was switched to other tabs by parallel sessions.
The detail view, orbit controls, hover-to-crack-open, drag-to-turn curved pages, per-book recoloring and generated audio are taken from the README text and were not observed.
No license file exists in the repository root and the README and index.html contain no license or copyright wording, so the project has no stated license.
requiresHostedService false is inferred from the README, which says there is no backend and only pinned Three.js modules and the Inter font are loaded from the network.
